generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: Three-row electric SUV (Toyota Highlander BEV sibling), 2027 model year: 76.96 or 95.82 kWh packs, up to 150 kW DC, NACS in the US and Canada, 11 or 19 kW onboard AC (EPA labels "11kW"/"19kW"). Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://pressroom.lexus.com/all-electric-three-row-luxury-the-all-new-2027-lexus-tz/ ; https://insideevs.com/news/795125/2027-lexus-tz-range-specs-photos-official/
